statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these intermittent symptoms.
The service supports the diagnoses of R55 and G45.9.
The claim was denied with reason code CO-29.
The denial is based on the time limit for filing having expired.
